prototype_note: These scenarios are predefined engineering validation cases for the AdaptiveSkill prototype. They are not a user study and do not establish behavioral or learning effectiveness.

scenarios.title: Safe Alternative Route
scenarios.instruction: Use a clearly different route from the expert prior while remaining outside the obstacle safety margin and reaching the target.
scenarios.validation_target: A valid alternative strategy should be preserved without task-aware assistance.

scenarios.title: Brief Obstacle Risk
scenarios.instruction: Briefly enter the obstacle safety margin, then return to a valid region before the risk persists for approximately 0.8 seconds.
scenarios.validation_target: A brief task risk should trigger minimal assistance only, followed by withdrawal after recovery.

scenarios.title: Persistent Obstacle Risk
scenarios.instruction: Remain inside the obstacle safety margin for longer than approximately 0.8 seconds without entering the obstacle, then recover and reach the target.
scenarios.validation_target: Persistent risk should escalate from minimal assistance to explicit task-safe correction.

scenarios.title: Persistent Orientation Risk
scenarios.instruction: Create an orientation error that first enters the mild-risk range and persists long enough to trigger explicit orientation guidance, then restore the object upright and reach the target.
scenarios.validation_target: Orientation assistance should progress from a minimal directional cue to explicit ghost-pose and degree guidance.

scenarios.title: Violation and Recovery
scenarios.instruction: Enter a task-constraint violation briefly, recover before strong-assistance escalation, then complete the task safely.
scenarios.validation_target: A real violation should trigger explicit correction, remain in trial history after recovery, and allow assistance to return to quiet.

scenarios.title: Persistent Violation
scenarios.instruction: Remain in a task-constraint violation for longer than approximately 2 seconds until strong assistance is triggered, then recover and reach the target.
scenarios.validation_target: Persistent violation should escalate to L3 strong assistance and later fade after recovery.
